## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (65%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set, MUSK agreement, 0% invasive probability; Normal is second at 35% [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 65%, Normal 35% | Benign leads |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.97 / 8th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Models agree |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign, all Normal | Neighbors disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; associated with lower invasive likelihood [F3] · Validated
- **Normal lobules** (regions 1, 4, 11) · ↓ invasive · Largest contribution, but failed AI spot check (0/20) [F2] · Unreliable
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Near typical; adds no invasive push here · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined to ducts** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Below typical; spot check only 12/20 [F4] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit, 0.47–0.60); heatmap is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules is Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) blurs Normal versus Benign; no similar case is Benign.
- Reliability only modestly flags errors (AUROC 0.69, small test set).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 4, 11**: confirm lobules are normal; the lobule concept failed its spot check.
2. **Regions 0, 10**: least benign-leaning by heatmap; check stroma and nuclear atypia.
3. **Region 8**: look for atypical cells confined within ducts.
